newsitem.title: USA: Sharper Image sees Q4 ESP of $0.04-$0.08.
newsitem.headline: Sharper Image sees Q4 ESP of $0.04-$0.08.

text.p: Sharper Image Corp on Thursday said it expected its fiscal fourth-quarter earnings to range between $0.04 and $0.08 a share, sharply lower than the $0.39 posted in the same period a year earlier.
The specialty retailer said it expected fourth-quarter net income of $300,000 to $700,000, versus net income of $3.4 million in the previous fourth quarter.
Shaper Image said results for the fourth quarter ending January 31, 1997, would include a charge of $4.8 million, or $0.56 a share, for the discontinuance of the SPA Collection division.
The net loss from operations for the SPA Collection division widened to $300,000, or 0.04 per share, from $200,000, or $0.03.

Excluding the SPA Collection division, fourth-quarter earnings were expected to rise by more than 50 percent to $5.4 million to $5.8 million, or $0.64 to $0.68 per share, from the $3.6 million, or $0.42.
Total fourth-quarter revenues rose to $85 million from $75.9 million. Same store sales rose to $55.6 million from $52.6 million.

Excluding SPA Collection division, earnings for the fiscal year ended January 31, were expected to rise to between $2.4 million and $2.8 million, or $0.28 to $0.32 per share, from $1.1 million, or $0.13.
The company expects to post full-year revenue to $199.1 million from $195.8 million the previous fiscal year.
